'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Nico Kreidl LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nico Kreidl]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
